prerequisites: Solid basic mathematical knowledge (analysis, differential equations, linear algebra, basic knowledge in mechanical engineering fundamentals for understanding various applications (mechanics, electrical engineering, ...), ability to present and communicate one's own solutions to given tasks.

learning_outcomes.text: Draw and interpret the root locus of a single-input system.
Determine simple single-input controllers using the root locus.
Write dynamic systems in state-space representation and analyze their properties.
Apply and parameterize different control concepts in state-space with or without state observers.
Analyze nonlinear single-input systems using the describing function.
Design a nonlinear control using exact linearization.
Assess the stability of a nonlinear system using Lyapunov theory.
Discuss designs and results constructively and critically.
Present complex content, models, and results appropriately for the audience.
Apply and adapt theoretical knowledge in practice.

syllabus_topics: Representation and analysis of single-input systems in state-space
Controller and observer design in state-space
teaching_methods: Numerous exercises: application of theoretically conveyed content through calculation and simulation examples
Extensive examples, available as complete MATLAB/Simulink packages for students
assessment_rules: Performance assessment is based on two written tests and one laboratory exercise part.
